hypotheses.justification: `Lem1211NNG2` is a closed `Prop`: `∀ Y [Group Y] [Finite Y] (X P : Subgroup Y), IsG2Two X → IsMaxParabolic2 X P → ¬ 7 ∣ Nat.card P`. It mentions neither `G` nor any other hypothesis of this theorem. The library already proves it unconditionally as `CFSG.Quasithin.H13.KGG2.lem1211NNG2_holds` (CFSG/Quasithin/Vol2/KGFactLem1211G2.lean:308, `theorem lem1211NNG2_holds : CFSG.Quasithin.H13.Lem1211NNG2`). Callers pass exactly that lemma as the argument (BigStmt.lean:42, ASC41F4.lean:258, C4Kernel.lean:1410). So the theorem stays true and provable without the binder. In the proof, `hG2` is used once, in `isSolvable_of_isMaxParabolic2_g2 hG2 hG2two hmax`. That call can be replaced by `isSolvable_of_isMaxParabolic2_g2 H13.KGG2.lem1211NNG2_holds hG2two hmax`, with the import `CFSG.Quasithin.Vol2.KGFactLem1211G2` added. That file imports only Ch12Sec1Lem1NNC (which imports C2Blocks), GH74.KGroups.U33, SBc11List, GammaFamiliesBasic and Certificate7137. None of the direct imports of those files are Milestones, Yardstones or H13 modules, or C41Pf files. I did not trace the full transitive import graph, so a cycle is not ruled out. I did not check whether `hC27`, `hA37` or `hA38` can be discharged the same way, so I report only `hG2`.
